verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ بِلْدَدُ ٱلشُّوحِيُّ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.web: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

verses.ar: «إِلَى مَتَى تَضَعُونَ أَشْرَاكًا لِلْكَلَامِ؟ تَعَقَّلُوا وَبَعْدُ نَتَكَلَّمُ.
verses.kjv: How long [will it be ere] ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.web: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

verses.ar: لِمَاذَا حُسِبْنَا كَٱلْبَهِيمَةِ، وَتَنَجَّسْنَا فِي عُيُونِكُمْ؟
verses.kjv: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, [and] reputed vile in your sight?
verses.web: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

verses.ar: يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُفْتَرِسُ نَفْسَهُ فِي غَيْظِهِ، هَلْ لِأَجْلِكَ تُخْلَى ٱلْأَرْضُ، أَوْ يُزَحْزَحُ ٱلصَّخْرُ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ؟
verses.kjv: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
verses.web: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

verses.ar: «نَعَمْ! نُورُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ يَنْطَفِئُ، وَلَا يُضِيءُ لَهِيبُ نَارِهِ.
verses.kjv: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.web: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.

verses.ar: ٱلنُّورُ يُظْلِمُ فِي خَيْمَتِهِ، وَسِرَاجُهُ فَوْقَهُ يَنْطَفِئُ.
verses.kjv: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
verses.web: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.

verses.ar: تَقْصُرُ خَطَوَاتُ قُوَّتِهِ، وَتَصْرَعُهُ مَشُورَتُهُ.
verses.kjv: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.web: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ رِجْلَيْهِ تَدْفَعَانِهِ فِي ٱلْمِصْلَاةِ فَيَمْشِي إِلَى شَبَكَةٍ.
verses.kjv: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
verses.web: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

verses.ar: يُمْسِكُ ٱلْفَخُّ بِعَقِبِهِ، وَتَتَمَكَّنُ مِنْهُ ٱلشَّرَكُ.
verses.kjv: The gin shall take [him] by the heel, [and] the robber shall prevail against him.
verses.web: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

verses.ar: مَطْمُورَةٌ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ حِبَالَتُهُ، وَمِصْيَدَتُهُ فِي ٱلسَّبِيلِ.
verses.kjv: The snare [is] laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
verses.web: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.

verses.ar: تُرْهِبُهُ أَهْوَالٌ مِنْ حَوْلِهِ، وَتَذْعَرُهُ عِنْدَ رِجْلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
verses.web: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.

verses.ar: تَكُونُ قُوَّتُهُ جَائِعَةً وَٱلْبَوَارُ مُهَيَّأٌ بِجَانِبِهِ.
verses.kjv: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction [shall be] ready at his side.
verses.web: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.

verses.ar: يَأْكُلُ أَعْضَاءَ جَسَدِهِ. يَأْكُلُ أَعْضَاءَهُ بِكْرُ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: It shall devour the strength of his skin: [even] the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
verses.web: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

verses.ar: يَنْقَطِعُ عَنْ خَيْمَتِهِ، عَنِ ٱعْتِمَادِهِ، وَيُسَاقُ إِلَى مَلِكِ ٱلْأَهْوَالِ.
verses.kjv: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
verses.web: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.

verses.ar: يَسْكُنُ فِي خَيْمَتِهِ مَنْ لَيْسَ لَهُ. يُذَرُّ عَلَى مَرْبِضِهِ كِبْرِيتٌ.
verses.kjv: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because [it is] none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.web: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

verses.ar: مِنْ تَحْتُ تَيْبَسُ أُصُولُهُ، وَمِنْ فَوْقُ يُقْطَعُ فَرْعُهُ.
verses.kjv: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.web: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

verses.ar: ذِكْرُهُ يَبِيدُ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ، وَلَا ٱسْمَ لَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِ ٱلْبَرِّ.
verses.kjv: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
verses.web: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

verses.ar: يُدْفَعُ مِنَ ٱلنُّورِ إِلَى ٱلظُّلْمَةِ، وَمِنَ ٱلْمَسْكُونَةِ يُطْرَدُ.
verses.kjv: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
verses.web: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

verses.ar: لَا نَسْلَ وَلَا عَقِبَ لَهُ بَيْنَ شَعْبِهِ، وَلَا شَارِدَ فِي مَحَالِّهِ.
verses.kjv: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.web: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

verses.ar: يَتَعَجَّبُ مِنْ يَوْمِهِ ٱلْمُتَأَخِّرُونَ، وَيَقْشَعِرُّ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ.
verses.kjv: They that come after [him] shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
verses.web: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا تِلْكَ مَسَاكِنُ فَاعِلِي ٱلشَّرِّ، وَهَذَا مَقَامُ مَنْ لَا يَعْرِفُ ٱللهَ».
verses.kjv: Surely such [are] the dwellings of the wicked, and this [is] the place [of him that] knoweth not God.
verses.web: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
